text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the selected candidate are women, meaning sex was almost certainly not a deciding factor in the hiring outcome. An all-female panel selecting one woman over another does not indicate sex discrimination or gender bias.

Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded and could harm your professional reputation. Instead, keep your focus entirely on merit and procedural fairness. Follow up politely regarding your requested written explanation, asking specifically how administrative leadership experience, formal qualifications, and interview performance were weighted against the job criteria.
